title: More Phrasal Verbs
sub: Everyday phrasal verbs beyond the basics.

cards.def:
to behave badly or not work properly
हिंदी: शरारत करना / ख़राबी दिखाना
examples: The kids are acting up again.
My laptop is acting up.
My car always acts up in the cold.
The printer started acting up just before the meeting.

cards.def:
to make sense; to total
हिंदी: हिसाब मिलना / समझ में आना
examples: His story doesn't add up.
The bills add up quickly.
The numbers in the report don't add up.
Small daily expenses add up to a lot by month end.

cards.def:
to withdraw a claim or demand
हिंदी: पीछे हट जाना
examples: He refused to back down.
She backed down after the warning.
The company backed down and withdrew the price rise.
Neither side wanted to back down in the argument.

cards.def:
to withdraw from an agreement
हिंदी: वादे से मुकर जाना
examples: He backed out of the deal.
Don't back out now.
Two speakers backed out of the conference at the last minute.
If you back out now, we'll lose the booking money.

cards.def:
to rescue from difficulty
हिंदी: संकट से उबारना
examples: The government bailed out the bank.
Can you bail me out?
My brother bailed me out when I lost my wallet.
The investors bailed out the struggling startup.

cards.def:
to explode; to get very angry
हिंदी: फट जाना / भड़क उठना
examples: The tyre blew up.
He blew up at me.
The gas cylinder blew up and damaged the kitchen.
My dad blew up when he saw my marks.

cards.def:
to be mainly about
हिंदी: सार यह निकलना कि
examples: It all boils down to money.
It boils down to trust.
The choice boils down to cost or comfort.
Good teamwork boils down to clear communication.

cards.def:
to recover quickly
हिंदी: जल्दी उबर जाना
examples: The team bounced back after defeat.
She bounced back from illness.
The economy bounced back after the slowdown.
He bounced back quickly after losing his job.

cards.def:
to expand into new areas
हिंदी: नए क्षेत्र में फैलना
examples: The firm branched out into software.
He branched out into films.
The bakery branched out into cakes and coffee.
After years in sales, she branched out into marketing.

cards.def:
to enter illegally; to interrupt
हिंदी: घुस आना / बीच में टोकना
examples: Thieves broke in last night.
Sorry to break in, but...
Someone broke in and stole our laptop.
May I break in with a quick question?

cards.def:
to start suddenly
हिंदी: अचानक शुरू हो जाना
examples: A fire broke out.
War broke out in 1939.
Panic broke out when the lights went off.
An argument broke out between the two drivers.

cards.def:
to make a major advance
हिंदी: बड़ी सफलता पाना
examples: Scientists broke through in cancer research.
She broke through the barrier.
The team finally broke through and won the trophy.
After years of trying, the band broke through with a hit song.

cards.def:
to cause to happen
हिंदी: ले आना / घटित करना
examples: The reforms brought about change.
What brought this about?
The internet brought about huge changes in banking.
Her hard work brought about a big improvement in sales.

cards.def:
to cause the fall of
हिंदी: गिरा देना / कम करना
examples: The scandal brought down the government.
Bring down the price.
The shop brought down prices to attract customers.
One bad decision brought down the whole company.

cards.def:
to move to an earlier time
हिंदी: पहले कर देना
examples: The meeting was brought forward.
Bring the date forward.
The exam has been brought forward to Monday.
Can we bring forward the meeting to ten?

cards.def:
to introduce; to earn
हिंदी: लाना / कमाई करना
examples: The law brought in new rules.
The shop brings in good money.
The school brought in a new uniform.
Her freelance work brings in extra income.

cards.def:
to increase gradually
हिंदी: धीरे-धीरे बढ़ाना
examples: Build up your strength slowly.
Traffic builds up at five.
Savings build up slowly over the years.
Tension built up before the results were announced.

cards.def:
to become exhausted from overwork
हिंदी: थककर चूर हो जाना
examples: He burned out after years of overwork.
Don't burn yourself out.
Many doctors burn out after years of long shifts.
Take breaks so you don't burn out.

cards.def:
to return a phone call
हिंदी: वापस फ़ोन करना
examples: I'll call you back later.
She called back at noon.
The bank called back to confirm my address.
Please call back after lunch; he's in a meeting.

cards.def:
to demand or require
हिंदी: माँग करना / ज़रूरत होना
examples: The situation calls for action.
They called for his resignation.
This recipe calls for two cups of rice.
Doctors called for stricter rules on junk food.

cards.def:
to become less angry or excited
हिंदी: शांत हो जाना
examples: Calm down and listen.
He calmed down after a while.
Calm down; we'll find your passport.
The crowd calmed down when the police arrived.

cards.def:
to perform or complete a task
हिंदी: कर दिखाना / अंजाम देना
examples: Police carried out the raid.
Carry out the instructions.
The team carried out a survey of customers.
Engineers carried out repairs overnight.

cards.def:
to profit from
हिंदी: फ़ायदा उठाना
examples: Shops cash in on festivals.
He cashed in on his fame.
Hotels cash in on the holiday season with high prices.
The company cashed in on the cricket craze.

cards.def:
to become happier
हिंदी: ख़ुश हो जाना
examples: Cheer up, things will improve.
The gift cheered her up.
A cup of chai always cheers me up.
Cheer up; you'll do better next time.

cards.def:
to contribute to a cost
हिंदी: मिलकर हिस्सा देना
examples: We all chipped in for the gift.
Everyone chipped in.
Everyone chipped in for the farewell cake.
Can you chip in with ideas for the event?

cards.def:
to act strictly against
हिंदी: सख़्ती से रोकना
examples: Police clamped down on speeding.
The state clamped down on fraud.
The city clamped down on illegal parking.
Schools are clamping down on phone use in class.

cards.def:
to make clear; to tidy
हिंदी: साफ़ करना / स्पष्ट करना
examples: Let's clear up the confusion.
Clear up the mess.
The weather cleared up by afternoon.
Can you clear up a doubt about the fees?

cards.def:
to stop operating
हिंदी: बंद हो जाना
examples: The factory closed down.
Many shops closed down.
The old cinema closed down last year.
Many small shops closed down during the lockdown.

cards.def:
to catch an illness
हिंदी: बीमार पड़ना
examples: I came down with a cold.
He came down with fever.
She came down with the flu before her trip.
Half the class came down with chickenpox.

cards.def:
to volunteer information
हिंदी: आगे आना
examples: Witnesses came forward.
Nobody came forward.
The police asked anyone with information to come forward.
Two employees came forward with complaints.

cards.def:
to succeed; to become detached
हिंदी: सफल होना / निकल जाना
examples: The plan didn't come off.
The button came off.
The handle came off the suitcase at the airport.
The surprise party came off perfectly.

cards.def:
to be published or revealed
हिंदी: प्रकाशित होना / सामने आना
examples: The truth came out.
Her book comes out in May.
The exam results come out next week.
The new phone comes out in October.

cards.def:
to change opinion; to regain consciousness
हिंदी: मान जाना / होश में आना
examples: He'll come round to the idea.
She came round after the surgery.
My parents came round to the idea of my moving abroad.
He fainted but came round in a few minutes.

cards.def:
to survive or deliver
हिंदी: खरा उतरना
examples: She came through in the crisis.
He always comes through.
When we needed help, our neighbours came through.
The patient came through the operation well.

cards.def:
to arise or be mentioned
हिंदी: सामने आना
examples: Something came up at work.
The topic came up.
Your name came up in the meeting today.
Sorry, something came up, and I can't come tonight.

cards.def:
to rely on
हिंदी: भरोसा करना
examples: You can count on me.
We're counting on your support.
You can always count on your family.
Can I count on you to finish this by Friday?

cards.def:
to deal strictly with
हिंदी: सख़्त कार्रवाई करना
examples: The police cracked down on crime.
Authorities cracked down on fraud.
The government is cracking down on tax evasion.
The school cracked down on bullying.

cards.def:
to reduce spending or amount
हिंदी: कटौती करना
examples: The firm cut back on costs.
Cut back on sugar.
We're cutting back on eating out to save money.
The factory cut back production during the slow season.

cards.def:
to stop supply; to interrupt
हिंदी: काट देना / बीच में रोकना
examples: Power was cut off.
He cut me off mid-sentence.
Our water was cut off for two hours.
The call got cut off in the tunnel.

cards.def:
to stop doing; to remove
हिंदी: छोड़ देना / काट देना
examples: Cut out junk food.
She cut out the article.
The doctor told me to cut out fried food.
Cut out the coupon from the newspaper.

cards.def:
to become less strong
हिंदी: कम पड़ जाना
examples: The storm died down.
The noise died down.
The excitement died down after the match.
Wait for the wind to die down before you go out.

cards.def:
to investigate deeply
हिंदी: गहराई से जाँचना
examples: Reporters dug into the case.
Let's dig into the data.
The auditors dug into last year's accounts.
Let's dig into why customers are leaving.

cards.def:
to get rid of
हिंदी: ख़त्म करना
examples: They did away with the old rule.
Do away with waste.
The company did away with paper forms.
We should do away with unnecessary meetings.

cards.def:
to fasten; to renovate
हिंदी: बाँधना / सजाना
examples: Do up your seatbelt.
They did up the house.
Do up your coat; it's cold outside.
They're doing up the old shop into a cafe.

cards.def:
to prepare a document or plan
हिंदी: मसौदा तैयार करना
examples: The lawyer drew up a contract.
Draw up a plan.
HR drew up a list of new policies.
Let's draw up a budget for the trip.

cards.def:
to wear formal or fancy clothes
हिंदी: सज-धजकर तैयार होना
examples: They dressed up for the party.
Dress up for the interview.
Everyone dressed up for the wedding.
The kids dressed up as superheroes for the school event.

cards.def:
to visit briefly
हिंदी: यूँ ही मिलने आना
examples: Drop by anytime.
He dropped by yesterday.
Drop by my desk if you have questions.
My aunt dropped by with sweets for Diwali.

cards.def:
to deliver; to fall asleep
हिंदी: छोड़ आना / ऊँघ जाना
examples: I'll drop off the parcel.
He dropped off during the film.
Can you drop off the kids at school?
I dropped off while reading on the sofa.

cards.def:
to leave a course or school
हिंदी: पढ़ाई बीच में छोड़ना
examples: He dropped out of college.
She dropped out of the race.
Some students drop out because of money problems.
Two players dropped out of the tournament.

cards.def:
to finally be in a situation
हिंदी: आख़िर में ... हो जाना
examples: We ended up walking home.
He ended up in Delhi.
We ended up eating at a roadside dhaba.
If you don't save, you'll end up in debt.

cards.def:
to break or fail completely
हिंदी: बिखर जाना
examples: The plan fell apart.
His life fell apart.
My old shoes are falling apart.
The team fell apart after the captain left.

cards.def:
to fail to keep pace
हिंदी: पिछड़ जाना
examples: She fell behind with her work.
Don't fall behind.
He fell behind with his loan payments.
If you miss classes, you'll fall behind.

cards.def:
to be tricked or fall in love
हिंदी: झाँसे में आना / प्यार हो जाना
examples: He fell for the scam.
She fell for him.
Many people fall for fake lottery messages.
He fell for her at the college fest.

cards.def:
to fail to happen
हिंदी: रद्द हो जाना / विफल होना
examples: The deal fell through.
Our plans fell through.
The flat purchase fell through at the last minute.
Our trip fell through because of the strike.

cards.def:
to belong to a group
हिंदी: घुल-मिल जाना
examples: She fits in well with the team.
He found it hard to fit in.
It took me a few months to fit in at the new school.
The new sofa fits in well with the room.

cards.def:
to complete what was started
हिंदी: काम पूरा करके दिखाना
examples: He never follows through.
Follow through on your promises.
She followed through on her plan to learn coding.
Managers must follow through on what they promise.

cards.def:
to make progress
हिंदी: आगे बढ़ना
examples: Hard work helps you get ahead.
She wants to get ahead in life.
Learning English can help you get ahead at work.
He works late to get ahead of his colleagues.

cards.def:
to travel; to avoid a problem
हिंदी: घूमना-फिरना / बच निकलना
examples: It's easy to get around the city.
He got around the rule.
The metro makes it easy to get around Delhi.
We found a way to get around the traffic jam.

cards.def:
to hint; to reach
हिंदी: इशारा करना / पहुँचना
examples: What are you getting at?
I can't get at the files.
I'm not sure what she's getting at with that comment.
Keep the medicines where children can't get at them.

cards.def:
to escape
हिंदी: बच निकलना
examples: The thief got away.
Let's get away this weekend.
We're planning to get away to the hills next month.
The robbers got away in a car.

cards.def:
to return; to recover
हिंदी: लौटना / वापस पाना
examples: When did you get back?
I got my money back.
I'll get back to the office by four.
She got back her lost phone from the cab driver.

cards.def:
to manage with difficulty
हिंदी: जैसे-तैसे गुज़ारा करना
examples: They get by on a small income.
I can get by on little.
We get by on one salary.
I know enough Hindi to get by in Delhi.

cards.def:
to begin seriously
हिंदी: गंभीरता से शुरू करना
examples: Let's get down to business.
He got down to work.
After small talk, we got down to the budget discussion.
It's time to get down to studying.

cards.def:
to progress; to board
हिंदी: आगे बढ़ना / चढ़ना
examples: How are you getting on?
Get on the bus.
How are you getting on with your new job?
We got on the train just before it left.

cards.def:
to survive or complete
हिंदी: पार पाना / पूरा करना
examples: I got through the exam.
We'll get through this.
I got through the interview without any problems.
We got through a difficult year together.

cards.def:
to meet socially
हिंदी: मिलना-जुलना
examples: Let's get together on Sunday.
Friends got together for dinner.
Our college group gets together every December.
The family got together for grandfather's birthday.

cards.def:
to be involved in
हिंदी: करने में लगे रहना
examples: What did you get up to?
The kids got up to mischief.
What did you get up to over the long weekend?
I wonder what the kids are getting up to upstairs.

cards.def:
to donate; to reveal
हिंदी: दान करना / राज़ खोल देना
examples: They gave away free books.
His smile gave him away.
We gave away our old clothes to the shelter.
Don't give away the ending of the movie!

cards.def:
to return
हिंदी: लौटा देना
examples: Give back my pen.
She gave back the money.
Please give back the book when you've finished it.
He volunteers on weekends to give back to the community.

cards.def:
to produce a smell or light
हिंदी: छोड़ना (गंध, रोशनी)
examples: The flowers give off a sweet smell.
The lamp gave off warmth.
The heater gives off a strange smell.
Rotting fruit gives off a bad odour.

cards.def:
to distribute; to stop working
हिंदी: बाँटना / जवाब दे जाना
examples: He gave out leaflets.
My legs gave out.
Volunteers gave out water bottles at the marathon.
The old fridge finally gave out last week.

cards.def:
to proceed
हिंदी: आगे बढ़ना / शुरू करना
examples: Go ahead and speak.
The project went ahead.
Can I go ahead and book the tickets?
The wedding went ahead despite the rain.

cards.def:
to agree with
हिंदी: सहमत होना
examples: I'll go along with your plan.
She went along with it.
I didn't like the idea, but I went along with it.
Most of the team went along with the manager's plan.

cards.def:
to explode; to ring; to spoil
हिंदी: फटना / बजना / ख़राब होना
examples: The alarm went off.
The milk has gone off.
My phone alarm went off at six.
The bomb went off near the market.

cards.def:
to review
हिंदी: दोहराना / जाँचना
examples: Let's go over the notes.
She went over the report.
Can we go over the plan once more?
The teacher went over the answers in class.

cards.def:
to experience or examine
हिंदी: गुज़रना / जाँचना
examples: He went through hard times.
Go through the file.
She went through a lot after her father's illness.
I went through all my emails this morning.

cards.def:
to manage lacking something
हिंदी: बिना गुज़ारा करना
examples: They went without food.
We can go without.
During the strike, many families went without a salary.
I can't go without my morning tea.

cards.def:
to become an adult
हिंदी: बड़ा होना
examples: She grew up in Pune.
When I grow up, I'll be a pilot.
I grew up in a small town near Nagpur.
Kids grow up so fast these days.

cards.def:
to submit
हिंदी: जमा करना
examples: Hand in your homework.
He handed in his resignation.
Please hand in your ID card on your last day.
Students must hand in assignments by Friday.

cards.def:
to distribute
हिंदी: बाँटना
examples: The teacher handed out papers.
They handed out food.
Volunteers handed out food packets to flood victims.
The trainer handed out notes after the session.

cards.def:
to wait; to hold tightly
हिंदी: ठहरिए / कसकर पकड़ना
examples: Hang on a second.
Hang on tight.
Hang on, I'll check my calendar.
Hang on to the railing on the stairs.

cards.def:
to spend time casually
हिंदी: समय बिताना / घूमना
examples: We hang out on weekends.
He hangs out with friends.
Teenagers love to hang out at the mall.
We used to hang out at the college canteen.

cards.def:
to depart; to prevent
हिंदी: निकल पड़ना / रोकना
examples: They headed off early.
He headed off a disaster.
We headed off to the airport at five.
Quick action headed off a strike at the factory.

cards.def:
to respond to an attack
हिंदी: पलटवार करना
examples: She hit back at critics.
The party hit back.
The actor hit back at the rumours on social media.
The company hit back with lower prices.

cards.def:
to restrain
हिंदी: रोके रखना
examples: She held back her tears.
Don't hold back.
I held back from saying what I really thought.
Fear of failure held her back for years.

cards.def:
to delay
हिंदी: टालना
examples: Hold off on the decision.
The rain held off.
Let's hold off on buying a car until next year.
The company held off hiring until the budget was clear.

cards.def:
to resist; to last
हिंदी: डटे रहना / टिकना
examples: The town held out for weeks.
Supplies won't hold out.
Our water supply won't hold out much longer.
The workers held out for better pay.

cards.def:
to delay; to rob
हिंदी: देरी करना / लूटना
examples: Traffic held us up.
Robbers held up the bank.
Sorry I'm late; I was held up in a meeting.
Two men held up the petrol pump last night.

cards.def:
to solve minor problems
हिंदी: छोटी समस्याएँ सुलझाना
examples: Let's iron out the details.
They ironed out the issues.
We need to iron out a few problems before launch.
The partners ironed out their differences over lunch.

cards.def:
to participate
हिंदी: शामिल होना
examples: Come and join in.
Everyone joined in the singing.
The whole office joined in the Holi celebration.
Feel free to join in the discussion.

cards.def:
to avoid
हिंदी: दूर रहना
examples: Keep away from the edge.
Keep away from strangers.
Keep away from the stray dogs near the gate.
Keep the medicines away from children.

cards.def:
to stay away from
हिंदी: दूर रखना
examples: Keep off the grass.
Keep off junk food.
Please keep off the wet floor.
I'm trying to keep off sugar this month.

cards.def:
to continue
हिंदी: लगातार करते रहना
examples: Keep on trying.
He kept on talking.
Keep on practising, and your English will improve.
The phone kept on ringing during the meeting.

cards.def:
to demolish
हिंदी: गिरा देना
examples: They knocked down the old building.
A car knocked him down.
The city knocked down the old bridge.
The cyclist was knocked down by a bike.

cards.def:
to make unconscious; to eliminate
हिंदी: बेहोश कर देना / बाहर कर देना
examples: He was knocked out.
They were knocked out of the cup.
The boxer knocked out his opponent in round two.
Our team was knocked out in the semi-final.

cards.def:
to dismiss workers
हिंदी: नौकरी से निकालना
examples: The company laid off staff.
He was laid off last month.
The factory laid off a hundred workers.
Many tech firms laid off staff this year.

cards.def:
to result in
हिंदी: ... की ओर ले जाना
examples: Stress leads to illness.
This led to confusion.
Skipping breakfast can lead to headaches.
Clear goals lead to better results.

cards.def:
to omit
हिंदी: छोड़ देना
examples: Don't leave anyone out.
He left out the details.
Please don't leave out any details in your report.
I felt left out when they didn't invite me.

cards.def:
to allow to enter
हिंदी: अंदर आने देना
examples: Let in some fresh air.
She let him in.
Open the window to let in some light.
The guard didn't let us in without ID.

cards.def:
to excuse from punishment
हिंदी: माफ़ कर देना / छोड़ देना
examples: The teacher let him off.
She was let off with a warning.
The police let him off with a warning.
The teacher let us off homework for the festival.

cards.def:
to arrange in a row
हिंदी: क़तार में लगना
examples: Students lined up for lunch.
Line up the chairs.
People lined up outside the bank at nine.
We've lined up three speakers for the event.

cards.def:
to survive using
हिंदी: ... पर जीना
examples: They live on a small pension.
He lives on rice.
Many students live on instant noodles.
My grandparents live on their savings.

cards.def:
to meet expectations
हिंदी: उम्मीदों पर खरा उतरना
examples: The film lived up to the hype.
He lived up to his name.
The new restaurant didn't live up to the reviews.
She worked hard to live up to her parents' hopes.

cards.def:
to exit an account
हिंदी: लॉग आउट करना
examples: Log out when you finish.
Don't forget to log out.
Always log out of your bank account on shared computers.
I logged out of all my social media accounts for a week.

cards.def:
to think about the past
हिंदी: पीछे मुड़कर देखना
examples: I look back on those days fondly.
She looked back at her career.
When I look back, college was the best time.
Don't look back; focus on the future.

cards.def:
to think of as inferior
हिंदी: तुच्छ समझना
examples: Don't look down on others.
He looks down on beginners.
Some people look down on manual work.
She never looks down on anyone, whatever their job.

cards.def:
to be careful
हिंदी: सावधान रहना
examples: Look out for the car!
Look out for scams.
Look out! There's a pothole ahead.
Look out for my message about the meeting time.

cards.def:
to examine quickly
हिंदी: सरसरी नज़र से जाँचना
examples: Look over my essay.
I'll look over the contract.
Can you look over my cover letter?
The mechanic looked over the car before the trip.

cards.def:
to search for information
हिंदी: खोजना / शब्दकोश में देखना
examples: Look up the word.
I looked up the address.
Look up the train times before we leave.
I looked up the restaurant's reviews online.

cards.def:
to admire
हिंदी: आदर करना
examples: I look up to my teacher.
Kids look up to him.
Many young players look up to Virat Kohli.
I've always looked up to my elder sister.

cards.def:
to understand or see with difficulty
हिंदी: मुश्किल से समझ पाना
examples: I can't make out his handwriting.
She couldn't make out the sign.
I could barely make out the voice on the bad line.
Can you make out what the sign says?

cards.def:
to compensate
हिंदी: भरपाई करना
examples: I'll make up for the delay.
Make up for lost time.
He bought her flowers to make up for forgetting her birthday.
We'll work Saturday to make up for the holiday.

cards.def:
to spoil
हिंदी: बिगाड़ देना
examples: I messed up the interview.
Don't mess up the plan.
I messed up the recipe and burnt the rice.
Don't mess up your chances by arriving late.

cards.def:
to lose a chance
हिंदी: मौक़ा गँवाना
examples: You'll miss out on the fun.
Don't miss out on this offer.
I missed out on the sale because I was busy.
Students who skip the trip will miss out.

cards.def:
to confuse one thing with another
हिंदी: गड़बड़ा देना
examples: I mixed up the dates.
They mixed up our names.
The twins are often mixed up by teachers.
I mixed up the meeting room and went to the wrong floor.

cards.def:
to progress; to forget the past
हिंदी: आगे बढ़ना
examples: It's time to move on.
Let's move on to the next topic.
After the breakup, she decided to move on.
If there are no questions, let's move on.

cards.def:
to reduce the number of options
हिंदी: विकल्प घटाना
examples: Narrow down the list.
We narrowed it down to two.
Let's narrow down the list of venues to three.
The police narrowed down the suspects.

cards.def:
to write briefly
हिंदी: लिख लेना
examples: Note down the address.
She noted down his number.
Note down the key points from the call.
I noted down the doctor's instructions.

cards.def:
to choose
हिंदी: चुनना
examples: She opted for a quiet life.
We opted for the cheaper plan.
Most customers opt for home delivery.
I opted for the vegetarian thali.

cards.def:
to die politely
हिंदी: चल बसना
examples: His grandfather passed away.
She passed away peacefully.
Our old neighbour passed away last week.
She passed away surrounded by her family.

cards.def:
to faint; to distribute
हिंदी: बेहोश होना / बाँटना
examples: He passed out in the heat.
They passed out sweets.
One runner passed out near the finish line.
The teacher passed out the exam papers.

cards.def:
to repay
हिंदी: चुका देना
examples: I'll pay you back tomorrow.
He paid back the loan.
I'll pay back the loan in twelve months.
He paid me back with interest.

cards.def:
to be successful; to finish paying
हिंदी: सफल होना / क़र्ज़ चुकाना
examples: Hard work pays off.
She paid off her debt.
All her late-night studying paid off.
We paid off the car loan early.

cards.def:
to stop gradually
हिंदी: धीरे-धीरे बंद करना
examples: They are phasing out plastic.
The scheme will be phased out.
The bank is phasing out cheque books.
Old buses will be phased out by 2030.

cards.def:
to treat unfairly
हिंदी: तंग करना
examples: Don't pick on him.
She was picked on at school.
The older boys picked on him because he was small.
Why does the manager always pick on me?

cards.def:
to accumulate
हिंदी: ढेर लगना
examples: Work piled up.
Bills pile up quickly.
Dirty dishes piled up while we were away.
Emails pile up when I'm on leave.

cards.def:
to make seem less important
हिंदी: कम महत्व दिखाना
examples: He played down the risk.
Don't play down the problem.
The minister played down the price rise.
She played down her role in the success.

cards.def:
to succeed in doing something difficult
हिंदी: कर दिखाना
examples: She pulled off a big deal.
He pulled off the trick.
We pulled off the surprise party without her knowing.
Nobody thought he could pull off the deal.

cards.def:
to recover
हिंदी: उबर जाना
examples: He pulled through the surgery.
We'll pull through.
The doctors say he will pull through.
The business pulled through the tough year.
